title: M3 (CH274) J0: counts-only pre-freeze check = the J1 extractor (sections 3.2-3.5) in dry mode (MEASUREMENT_M3_CH274.md 10.1): one read-only pass over the last 8 days of snapshots (rows, sidecar) and the retained gamma_rules day files, 12-capture fold plus one k - 1 capture, printing the funnel E1-E8 with sub-counts, units a day, events and units per event, S1-S13 cell counts, the near-seen set size, the classed share overall and by tier, cat_k with raw fee_category, the rule reader's day-file contiguity from 20261020, the E6 status forms on candidate rows only, receipt gaps, t_d_source, sports and crypto candidate counts, the planned follow-up volume and decision rule (a); writes no unit, status, follow-up, proposal-set or state file

notes: DRAFT (not in jobs/). J1 code on branch feat/m3-code (commits 76b1d6a6, 7bce38c8); promote only after the code note (reviews/M3_CODE_NOTE_2026-10-30.md) is read by the orchestrator and the reading list there is ruled, and after the commit is merged and its code_sha recorded. Counts only, k = 0, uncounted. Read-only on every store; refuses roots that are not research_lab/snapshots and research_lab/stream_gamma_rules, missing roots, an output outside a research_lab directory and an existing output (write-once by os.link, exit 1); exits 75 above the 50 GiB bulk-directory guard or under 1 GiB free; exits 3 with expected and actual values on a pin mismatch of any of the eight imported modules or the lexicon. Lane cpu (local stores only). Memory: import baseline about 170 MB (numpy and pyarrow come with census_map_ch269); sets and ledger of an 8-day span are small; mem_mb 600 per the text's 'under 600 MB'; peak_rss_mb is recorded in the output and the host dry run (q0781) must confirm it at end-of-window size. The first 12 captures only fold (the registered look-back is 84 slots, disclosed); one more capture is the k - 1 of the first classified k. No follow-up, proposal state, exit, price after k or resolution is read for a hypothetical unit after its k: a market in the near-seen set is skipped without parsing its prices (test_j0_reads_no_post_k_content_for_a_hypothetical_unit). The design text is a DRAFT, so the seal records its sha256 and a spec_sha computed from the SPEC constants (spec_sha_kind draft_constants_canonical_json). Runs under the heavy-job lock convention, never beside a multi-GB job.
